title: React useEffect Cleanup
description: Understand useEffect cleanup functions and when they run.

options.text: The cleanup function runs before the component mounts
options.explanation: The cleanup function runs: (1) before each re-run of the effect (when dependencies change), and (2) when the component unmounts. NOT before initial mount.

options.text: useEffect cleanup runs before the next effect execution and on unmount
options.explanation: React runs the cleanup from the previous render's effect before running the new effect. This prevents stale closures and memory leaks from subscriptions, timers, or event listeners.

options.text: An empty dependency array [] means the effect runs on every render
options.explanation: [] means the effect runs ONCE after initial render (mount) and cleanup runs on unmount. No dependency array means it runs after every render.

options.text: Cleanup functions are optional and React handles all cleanup automatically
options.explanation: React does NOT auto-cleanup side effects. If your effect sets up a subscription, timer, or event listener, you MUST return a cleanup function to avoid memory leaks.
